description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying {2}{G}{U}. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Altered Ego into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Altered Ego dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Altered Ego that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Altered Ego token instead.
